data: Microsoft delivered steady top-line expansion in fiscal 2023, with revenue rising 6.9% to $211.9 billion from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit increased to $146.1 billion in fiscal 2023 from $135.6 billion in fiscal 2022, supporting a fiscal 2023 gross margin of 68.9%. Operating income climbed to $88.5 billion in fiscal 2023 from $83.4 billion in fiscal 2022, which translates into a fiscal 2023 operating margin of 41.8% and underscores the company's scale and pricing power. Below the operating line the picture was flatter. Net income slipped 0.5% to $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023 from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022, while diluted EPS edged up to $9.68 from $9.65. Management kept investing for growth, lifting R&D expense to $27.2 billion in fiscal 2023 from $24.5 billion in fiscal 2022.
